{"id":1919839171,"question_id":4212,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1771141389,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"2 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1919839171/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Toggle Light Bulbs","memory":"34.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> toggleLightBulbs(vector<int>& bulbs) {\n        vector<int>ans;\n        set<int>st;\n        for(auto it : bulbs){\n            if(!st.count(it)) st.insert(it);\n            else st.erase(it);\n        }\n        for(auto it : st) ans.push_back(it);\n        return ans;\n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"toggle-light-bulbs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1710}
